title: Good Substrings
statementMd:
You are given a string 𝑠s of length 𝑛n, consisting only of digits.

A substring of 𝑠s is a contiguous subsequence of its characters. A substring 𝑠𝑙…𝑟sl…r is bad if it contains the string 20252025 as a subsequence and **doesn't** contain the string 20262026 as a subsequence. Otherwise, the substring is good. For example, the strings 20252025, 7270727572707275, 2062520625 are bad, but the strings 2025620256, 20262026, 777777, 12907235761290723576 are good.

For each index 𝑖i from 11 to 𝑛n, calculate the number of good substrings that contain it. In other words, for each index 𝑖i from 11 to 𝑛n, calculate the number of pairs of integers 𝑙,𝑟l,r such that 1≤𝑙≤𝑖≤𝑟≤𝑛1≤l≤i≤r≤n and the substring 𝑠𝑙…𝑟sl…r is good.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer 𝑡t (1≤𝑡≤1041≤t≤104) — the number of test cases.

The first line of each test case contains a single integer 𝑛n (1≤𝑛≤3⋅1051≤n≤3⋅105).

The second line contains a string 𝑠s of length 𝑛n, consisting of digits.

Additional constraint on the input: the sum of 𝑛n across all test cases does not exceed 3⋅1053⋅105.

## Output

For each test case, print 𝑛n integers. The 𝑖i-th integer should be equal to the number of good substrings that contain index 𝑖i.
